items.question: Who does Becky Hammon coach?
items.answer: As of October 2026, Becky Hammon is the head coach of the Las Vegas Aces. The Aces hired her on December 31, 2021, after she was a San Antonio Spurs assistant from 2014 to 2022. The Aces site lists WNBA titles in 2022, 2023, and 2025, the 2022 Coach of the Year award, and the 2022 Commissioner's Cup.

items.question: Who is Becky Hammon?
items.answer: Becky Hammon is the head coach of the Las Vegas Aces and a former WNBA guard. The Aces site says she played 16 seasons, from 1999 to 2014, went undrafted in 1999 after Colorado State, and was inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame on August 12, 2023. She was also inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame in 2022. She retired as a player after the 2014 season.
